summary: Kanban fetch on mount ignores parent filters/search/URL params — empty deps + no query passthrough overwrites the filtered prop.
scenario: Manager filters ownerId=Sara then toggles kanban; mount fetch returns full role-scoped pipeline; drag-drop affects wrong cards.
recommended_fix: Pass searchParams into the fetch (scope/repId/companyId/productId/q) and re-fetch when filters change; or accept the prop as authoritative when present.

summary: Bulk set-stage skips activity-quota gate, date-stamping side effects, CrmActivityLog write, and race-gate on source stage.
scenario: Manager bulk-moves 30 DISCOVERY→CONTACTED; quota policy bypassed; dateContacted/dateDiscovery never stamped; SLA reports drift; activity feed empty; concurrent rep moves clobbered.
recommended_fix: Factor a shared 'apply stage change to one opp' helper used by single-opp, drag-drop and bulk paths; include quota check, date stamping, activity-log write, and the updateMany pinned to source stage with a per-row skipped/conflict result aggregated into the response.

summary: WON declares depositRequired but modal never validates it; depositAmount initial 0 sends undefined → server skips persist.
scenario: Rep moves to WON, leaves depositAmount=0, clicks Confirm — depositRequired check absent, server writes nothing, opp WON with no deposit visible to finance.
recommended_fix: Add depositRequired validation in handleSubmit (require depositAmount>0 + depositDate when requirements.depositRequired); send `depositAmount: depositAmount` (not `|| undefined`) so 0 becomes a real validation error server-side.

summary: Activity-quota gate fires on moves into terminal stages — reps cannot mark dead deals LOST without first logging fake calls.
scenario: DISCOVERY quota requires 2 calls; rep drags ghosted opp to LOST; checkActivityQuota called unconditionally; returns 'X more calls required'; 400.
recommended_fix: Skip checkActivityQuota when newStage in ('LOST','POSTPONED') or matches any CrmStageConfig where stageType in ('lost','abandoned'); apply same carve-out to actions.ts:642-645.

summary: Quota counts scheduled-future and DENIED/CANCELLED meetings + NO_ANSWER calls — trivially bypassable with two stub meetings.
scenario: Quota requires 2 meetings in 30d; rep books 2 future PENDING_APPROVAL meetings; count returns 2; gate clears.
recommended_fix: For meetings: `where: { startAt: { gte: since, lte: new Date() }, status: { in: ['APPROVED','CONFIRMED','DONE'] } }`. For calls: `where: { outcome: { in: ['ANSWERED','LEFT_VOICEMAIL', ...] } }`.

summary: Admin can save activityType='email' but evaluator fails-open on email — quota silently does nothing.
scenario: Save email quota; cron/move ignores it; admin sees rule active but no enforcement.
recommended_fix: Add an email branch (count CrmEmail rows or similar) OR drop 'email' from the admin upsert enum until wired.

summary: canTransition returns allowed:true for unknown source codes (NaN comparisons in STAGE_ORDER) — admin-added stages bypass the entire transition matrix.
scenario: Admin creates PILOT stage; rep drags PILOT→WON; STAGE_ORDER['PILOT']=undefined; comparisons false; returns allowed:true.
recommended_fix: Build STAGE_ORDER dynamically from CrmStageConfig (displayOrder) at evaluation time; reject any transition where fromOrder or toOrder is undefined unless explicitly allowed.

summary: closesDeal hardcoded to 'WON'/'LOST' despite v11 promise to honor CrmStageConfig.stageType — custom terminal stages don't stamp dateClosed.
scenario: Admin sets stageType='won' on custom stage 'WON_DEAL'; rep drags there; closesDeal=false; dateClosed null; won-rate KPIs miss the deal.
recommended_fix: Select stageType in the stageCfg findFirst (line 198-201); compute closesDeal = stageType==='won'||'lost' OR newStage==='WON'||'LOST'; mirror in bulk/route.ts.

summary: Postgres NULLS FIRST under DESC inverts the per-entity-wins dedupe — global rows beat per-entity overrides.
scenario: Two rows: entityId=null + entityId='A'; orderBy entityId desc puts null first; dedupe keeps null; per-entity custom label lost.
recommended_fix: Use `{ entityId: { sort: 'desc', nulls: 'last' } }` (Prisma supports this) or sort in JS after fetch using a stable per-entity-first comparator.

summary: Folder bulk-assign has no CONVERTED/ARCHIVED filter and writes no CrmColdLeadDisposition audit rows.
scenario: Manager bulk-assigns folder containing CONVERTED leads; status flipped to ASSIGNED while convertedOpportunityId still set; no audit trail.
recommended_fix: Add `status: { notIn: ['CONVERTED','ARCHIVED'] }` to the findMany; pair every update with a `crmColdLeadDisposition.create` matching distribute/redistribute.

summary: Folder DELETE with deleteLeads=true cascades through CONVERTED leads — orphans linked CrmOpportunity.convertedFromColdLead FK.
scenario: Manager deletes folder with deleteLeads=true; deleteMany has no convertedOpportunityId filter; CONVERTED leads hard-deleted; opp.convertedFromColdLead dangles.
recommended_fix: Filter the deleteMany with `convertedOpportunityId: null` and surface a 409 / partial result for the skipped CONVERTED rows.

summary: PATCH admin override lets a manager flip CONVERTED→NEW while leaving convertedOpportunityId set.
scenario: Manager PATCH {status:'NEW'} on CONVERTED lead; line 177 branch wipes assignedToId; convertedOpportunityId preserved; bulk-delete refuses, but distribute/folder-assign happily re-assign.
recommended_fix: Symmetrize the line-165 guard: any transition out of CONVERTED must null convertedOpportunityId (or be rejected unless lead has no linked opp / opp is deleted).

summary: Disposition writers use `crmProfileId!` — platform super_admin without CRM profile triggers 500 inside the tx, rolling back distribute.
scenario: super_admin (no CrmUserProfile) clicks Distribute on a folder; auth passes; tx aborts on null repId; whole round-robin rolls back.
recommended_fix: Skip the disposition row when crmProfileId is null (or insert a system-actor sentinel id); add a try/catch + log around the audit insert so the primary update never rolls back.

summary: DELETE publishes data.invalidate but the thread uses raw fetch+setInterval, not react-query — v11 SSE fix is a no-op.
scenario: Rep A deletes comment; DELETE publishes ['comments',id]; NotificationCenter invalidates a query no one subscribed to; Rep B waits 30s for poll.
recommended_fix: Either subscribe the thread to react-query (and use the invalidation), or wire a direct SSE listener in OpportunityComments that re-fetches on `data.invalidate` for ['comments', oppId].

summary: Renderer falls through to raw cuid for any mention the server filtered out — in-thread cuid leak persists despite v11 bell-preview fix.
scenario: Rep pastes @cross-entity-cuid; server stores body verbatim; validMentions filter drops; renderer's regex matches; byId.get undefined; literal @<25-char-cuid> shown to every viewer.
recommended_fix: In renderBody, fall back to '@?' (or strip the token) when byId.get(id) is undefined; mirror the server's previewBody approach.

summary: Optimistic preserve race with in-flight POST produces two rows with the same React key.
scenario: Optimistic row pushed; poll fires before POST resolves; load() merges canonical+optimistic; POST resolves and maps optimistic→canonical; list now has two rows with id=xyz.
recommended_fix: Dedupe in the POST resolution: filter out any prev row whose id matches the canonical id before applying the swap (or never preserve an optimistic row whose pending POST has already resolved).

summary: Any CRM user can POST visibility=EVERYONE with arbitrary sharedWithIds — no crmRole check, no entity scope on share targets.
scenario: REP posts {visibility:'EVERYONE'}; ownerOrNull only checks module; dashboard appears on every CRM user's /crm/my; same for SPECIFIC with arbitrary ids.
recommended_fix: Gate POST visibility===EVERYONE on `session.user.crmRole === 'ADMIN'`; intersect sharedWithIds with `resolveShareTargets` that filters by entity/role (mirror PATCH).

summary: POST isShared gate ORs cross-module admin roles; PATCH gates per-module — non-CRM-admin partners-admin can publish CRM shared views via POST.
scenario: Partners-admin (no CRM ADMIN) POSTs scope='crm-opportunities', isShared=true; module gate passes (has crm); isAdmin true via partners disjunct; row created shared.
recommended_fix: Replace POST's cross-module isAdmin with the same per-scope `isModuleAdmin` block PATCH uses.

summary: POST filters/sort/columns have no size cap — v11 8KB boundedJson applied only to PATCH.
scenario: User POSTs filters with 5 MB blob; persisted to DB; shared views balloon every GET.
recommended_fix: Reuse boundedJson from [id]/route.ts in createSchema; also add a server-side body size limit at the route level.

summary: moduleForScope only recognizes hr/crm/partners — task scopes 'tasks:my:*'/'tasks:entity:*' return null → 403 for every user.
scenario: TaskList sends scope='tasks:my:mine'; moduleForScope returns null; GET and POST return 403; toolbar quietly fails.
recommended_fix: Add a 'tasks' branch returning a virtual module the user always has (or skip module gating for the 'tasks' prefix and check task RBAC separately).

summary: Excel safeLabel applied only to pivot headers; data cells (customerCompanyName, customerContactPhone, leadSource, owner name) write raw — formula injection.
scenario: Rep sets customerCompanyName='=HYPERLINK(...)'; export writes verbatim; manager opens .xlsx; formula evaluates.
recommended_fix: Wrap every r.getCell(...).value assignment in safeLabel for any string-typed column; move safeLabel to a shared util and apply consistently.

summary: wonValue tile reads loss.totals.wonValueEGP but the endpoint never returns it — KPI permanently 0.
scenario: Manager opens sales-report; tile renders 0 EGP regardless of real won revenue.
recommended_fix: Either add wonValueEGP to loss-analytics totals (sum estimatedValueEGP for WON in window) or change the client to fetch from win-rate-cube where wonValue exists.

summary: GET passes startDate/endDate into new Date() unvalidated; malformed input becomes Invalid Date → Prisma 500.
scenario: ?startDate=abc → endOfDay computes Invalid Date → Prisma throws → 500.
recommended_fix: Validate dates via a zod ISO/date schema at the top of GET; return 400 with a field-level error on parse failure.

summary: page has no upper bound; cross-module pagination runs both findMany in parallel — page=10M triggers two huge-skip scans.
scenario: Admin or stale link sends page=9999999; skip ≈ 5e8 against HrAuditLog and PartnerAuditLog in parallel.
recommended_fix: Clamp page to a sane max (e.g. Math.min(page, Math.ceil(totalCount/PAGE_SIZE))); short-circuit when both module counts are known and skip exceeds totals.

summary: Test-fire payload lacks entity fields; predicates always evaluate false; UI toast says 'fired' but run log stays empty.
scenario: Admin tests opp.stage.changed with priority=HOT condition; payload missing priority; conditionOk=false; no run row written; UI shows green success.
recommended_fix: In test-fire, hydrate the entity by entityType+entityId and spread its fields into the payload (same fix as Rank 4).

summary: Suppression row written unconditionally even when no notification was created (channels=['slack'], targetUserId null) — silent forever-skip.
scenario: Rule with channels=['slack']; in-app branch skipped; fire row still inserted; next tick is suppressed; partner never alerted.
recommended_fix: Move the crmAlertRuleFire.create inside a conditional that succeeded — write only when a real notification (or future channel adapter) delivered.

summary: PATCH allows scope change without re-validating predicateJson — re-purposing a rule silently dead.
scenario: PATCH scope=coldLead on a rule whose predicate references 'stage'; cron evaluates against cold leads with no stage field; eq returns false; never fires.
recommended_fix: In patchSchema, refuse a scope change unless predicateJson is also supplied; or validate predicateJson field paths against scope on every PATCH.

summary: GET /api/crm/calls?repId= overrides REP role-scope; rep can read any rep's calls.
scenario: REP appends ?repId=<other-rep>; `where.callerId = filters.repId` replaces the scoped callerId; full call history + linked PII returned.
recommended_fix: For REP role, ignore filters.repId or enforce `if (filters.repId && filters.repId !== session.id) return 403`; merge via AND for managers.

summary: POST accepts client-supplied status — REP can create meetings already APPROVED or DONE.
scenario: REP posts {status:'APPROVED'}; row created skipping assistant queue; approvedById left null.
recommended_fix: Force `status: 'PENDING_APPROVAL'` in the create (drop from createSchema); enforce APPROVED only via /approve endpoint with role gate.

summary: Cross-rep product-overlap check runs outside the advisory-locked tx; the lock key is hash(scheduledById) so reps don't serialize.
scenario: Rep A and Rep B both book customerNeed='POS' at the same slot; productConflict pre-tx returns null for both; locks don't contend (different keys); both inserts succeed.
recommended_fix: Acquire a second advisory lock keyed on hash(customerNeed + startHourBucket) inside the tx; re-run the product-overlap findFirst (including customerNeed) inside the lock before insert.

summary: Meeting code generator is a plain read with no advisory lock — concurrent creates collide on @unique(code) → opaque 500.
scenario: Two reps create meetings same second; both compute MTG-00100; second insert throws P2002; catch only intercepts __CONFLICT__ string; 500 to user.
recommended_fix: Refactor to use the same generateOpportunityCode lock pattern, BUT pass the tx in and call code-gen + INSERT inside one tx (also fix the Rank 56 auto-code defect at the same time).

summary: Per-id GET returns full PII (contactPhone, contactName, customerNeed, notes, deniedReason) to non-scheduler — v11 only masked the list endpoint.
scenario: Assistant who once approved meeting M opens GET /api/crm/meetings/<M>; reads customer phone+name+need+notes+denyReason verbatim.
recommended_fix: Apply the same mask the list endpoint uses to the single-id GET; if business needs an approver-only view, scope-mask by role.

summary: Manager booking on behalf can attach meeting to a different rep's opportunity (manager branch skips ownerId check).
scenario: Manager POSTs {scheduledById: repA, opportunityId: repB_opp}; oppOwnerCheck spreads {} for managers; meeting binds rep A to rep B's deal.
recommended_fix: Even for managers, require `ownerId IN [scheduledById]` OR an explicit assigned-shadow link; do not silently allow cross-owner attachment.

summary: Single-row OT approve has no canAccessCompany / subordinate check — team_lead newly granted by v11 can approve any company's OT.
scenario: team_lead in Company A POSTs approve on a Company B OT id; can(authUser,'overtime:approve') passes; calculatedAmount written.
recommended_fix: Add `if (!canAccessCompany(authUser, ot.employee.companyId)) return 403`; for team_lead also require employee's directManagerId === self (or subordinate chain).

summary: Incidents GET grants accountant/hr_manager/ceo isPrivileged with no company-scope filter; ?company= has no allowlist.
scenario: Accountant scoped to Company A sees all companies' disciplinary records; ?company=companyB accepted verbatim.
recommended_fix: Add `else if (!hasAnyRole(authUser,['super_admin'])) where.employee = { companyId: { in: authUser.companies } }` like bonuses; intersect ?company= with the allowed set.

summary: Incident create has no cross-company gate — HR manager in Company A can write a disciplinary action against a Company B employee.
scenario: POST {employee:<companyB_emp>, violation_rule, incident_date}; only isHROrAdmin; incident created; deduction computed against B's payroll.
recommended_fix: Lookup employee, then `if (!canAccessCompany(authUser, employee.companyId)) return 403` before writing.

summary: GET grants 'view all' to accountant/ceo with no company-scope filter; cross-tenant employee + salary + nationalId + IBAN leak.
scenario: Accountant in Company A hits /api/hr/employees; canViewAllEmployees true; no companyId scope; full roster of all companies returned.
recommended_fix: Inside canViewAllEmployees branch, additionally scope `where.companyId = { in: authUser.companies }` unless super_admin.

summary: Employee create silently hijacks an existing User account when work_email matches — forces hrAccess=true and binds the new HrEmployee.userId.
scenario: HR manager creates employee with work_email=existing CEO's email; transaction flips CEO.hrAccess=true and rebinds HrEmployee.userId to CEO.id; identity confusion / privilege flag manipulation.
recommended_fix: On existingUser match, return 409 'email already in use'; require an explicit consent flow (target user verifies and opts in to HR module).

summary: Violation rule offense_N.deduction_pct unbounded (no min/max) — hr_manager can save 999% or negative deduction.
scenario: Admin POSTs offense_1.deduction_pct=999; first incident under rule yields deductionAmount = 9.99 * baseSalary.
recommended_fix: Tighten offenseSchema: `deduction_pct: z.number().min(0).max(100)` (or z.union with string coercion); reject negative or >100.

summary: PATCH cross-company gate only validates CURRENT employee, not NEW employee when data.employee is supplied — bonus can be reassigned to a Company B employee.
scenario: Company A HR PATCH {employee:<companyB_emp>}; existing.companyId check passes (Company A); update writes employeeId; bonus now in Company B.
recommended_fix: If data.employee is provided, also lookup target employee and `canAccessCompany(authUser, target.companyId)` before writing; re-run payroll-lock against target's company.

summary: PATCH lets HR rewrite dates of an already-APPROVED leave — no status guard, no attendance-log re-fan.
scenario: Approved leave 20-24 has attendance 'leave' rows; HR PATCH new range 27-31; 20-24 rows orphaned, 27-31 absent.
recommended_fix: Refuse PATCH on status='approved'/'denied' (require revoke+re-create) OR transactionally clear old day rows and upsert new ones.

summary: Deny route was not given the updateMany race-gate that approve has — concurrent denies double-fire notifications.
scenario: Two HR managers click Deny; both pass read-check; both run regular update; last-write-wins; two 'Leave Denied' notifications sent.
recommended_fix: Replace update with `updateMany({where:{id,status:'pending'},...})` and short-circuit with 409 when count=0; mirror approve.

summary: Leave approve has no cross-company gate — HR manager in Company A can approve leave for Company B (same hole on deny).
scenario: Manager POSTs approve on companyB leave id; isHROrAdmin only; status flipped, attendance written for foreign employee.
recommended_fix: Add `if (!canAccessCompany(authUser, lr.employee.companyId)) return 403`; mirror on deny route.
